label: TypeScript and JavaScript performance budgets (vitest bench)
description: The project's vitest bench benchmarks, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a bench script running vitest bench in package.json; runs only where performance is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
